# Jaime Chapinal

> Jaime Chapinal is a Senior Software Engineer building Web and Desktop clients at Spotify and the independent maker behind Chapiware, a family of local-first, privacy-first apps.

## About

- Location and profile: https://jaimechapinal.com/
- Career: Senior Software Engineer at Spotify; experience in web, desktop, games, developer tools, and client quality platforms.
- Independent work: Chapiware builds calm, local-first apps for memories, habits, reading, and personal data. No account, cloud, or tracking is required for its products.
